name: run-progress
title: RunProgress
description: Progress card of a running test (TestRun, AgentTestRun): the big count done, what runs now, one segment per step, the counts by result and a step control.

a11y.pattern: <section aria-label="Progress"> with the count as text, a role="img" bar named by the count and a polite live region for the current step
aria: The segment bar is role="img" named "5 of 7 test steps done"
"Now calling" is aria-live="polite": the current step is announced when it changes
Each count writes its word next to a decorative icon; the current segment's pulse stops under reduced motion
